answer: Attention Decay Escrow. Each identity must continuously solve fresh, memory-hard challenges whose solutions span hours; missing a window reshuffles a dune of expired proofs that voids prior work. A partial cipher from any skipped round marks the identity as suspect, and a stale relic of past effort grants no credit toward renewal. Attacker cost: parallel identities require genuine, non-parallelizable compute-hours, so N fakes cost N times the sustained attention a single honest agent spends.
